archived_s5_separate_reference.scope: Same matched OHLC and dates, immutable archived native S5. Originally submitted plans only, no RC2 tape and no rejected or unsubmitted counterfactuals. Separate reference; no policy gates tested on S5 and no combined-slot results.

control: Original all-model Shadow scanner, existing approved diagnostic offers only, grouped one slot. Compare each frozen gate independently. Retests unchanged. Reproduce previously registered independent per-model journals first.

hypotheses.minimum_body_0_75_atr: Directional confirmation candle body must be at least 0.75 prior ATR.
hypotheses.minimum_clearance_0_15_atr: Directional distance from the known breakout edge to the confirmation close must be at least 0.15 prior ATR.
hypotheses.one_more_close_held: Next contiguous completed close must still be beyond the original edge. No earlier reservation or trade; submit then for following open with original geometry and original deviation cap.

limit: All dates archival and same market. No S5/native changes, optimization or independent forward evidence. Retrospective three-close reclaim is an evaluation label only. Closed campaign P&L excludes censored outcomes. Stress changes only execution costs, preserving original offers. Chronological sections are descriptive. No statistical significance or promotion claim.

precision_fast_cross_check.scope: Fixed originally filled FAST BREAKOUT campaigns. Threshold transferred without refitting. Same underlying M5 market period, different engine and cost semantics. No open/occupancy backfill or unseen evaluation.

source: Historical OHLC research on OANDA:XAUUSD M5
